# Yog Jivan — Authentic Indian Yoga, Live

Website: https://yogjivan.com
Business: Yog Jivan Sanctuary
Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher: Master Anil Choudhary (12+ years teaching authentic Indian yoga)
Community: 10,000+ students guided, 20+ countries served

## In one paragraph

Yog Jivan is an authentic Indian yoga school founded by Master Anil Choudhary, Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher. It runs two studios in the Hai Duong urban area of Hai Phong, Vietnam, live small-group online classes worldwide (maximum 8 students, 60 minutes, camera on for real-time correction), and private 1-on-1 online yoga with a matched teacher from the Yog Jivan teaching team. Teaching is available in English, Vietnamese and Hindi, subject to teacher availability.

## Locations

Note on geography: the former Hai Duong province merged into Hai Phong on 1 July 2025. The current official city is Hai Phong; "Hai Duong" remains the familiar local name for the urban area where both studios are.

Studio 1 — Yog Jivan Sanctuary
Address: Tầng 1 Nhà Thi Đấu Số 1, Bùi Thị Xuân, Phường Lê Thanh Nghị, Thành phố Hải Phòng 170000, Vietnam
Local area: Hai Duong urban area
Aerial yoga: available

## Live online classes

- Live small-group online classes are led by Master Anil Choudhary, Founder & Lead Yoga Teacher
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Maximum live group size: 8 students
- Camera on required, so alignment can be corrected in real time
- Languages: English, Vietnamese, Hindi
- Missed a class? A catch-up recording is available to members for 48 hours
- Before your first class: a short 15-minute onboarding and practice-safety conversation

## Pricing (live online memberships, USD)

- 1 month — $36
- 3 months — $99 (about $33 per month)
- 6 months — $180 (about $30 per month)
- 12 months — $300 (about $25 per month)

Studio (VND) rates are shared directly on request. 1-on-1 private and corporate packages are quoted individually.

## Refunds

Memberships are generally non-refundable once activated or after the first class is used. Exceptions always apply: duplicate payment, cancellation or non-delivery by Yog Jivan, material service failure, and any rights under applicable consumer law. Contact hello@yogjivan.com.

## Programs

- Private one-on-one yoga sessions (in-studio and online)
- Studio group classes and memberships
- Live online yoga classes (global)
- Adapted yoga practice for mobility, relaxation, cycle-aware practice and general wellbeing (not medical treatment)
- Yoga for beginners
- Corporate wellness — on-site, hybrid, virtual
- Kids yoga
- Retreat and nature experiences

## Styles taught

Classical Hatha, Ashtanga, pranayama (breathwork), meditation and individualized supportive practice — rooted in authentic Indian tradition and adapted for modern lifestyles.

## Common questions

Q: Is there a yoga studio near me in Hai Duong?
A: Yes — Yog Jivan operates two studios in the Hai Duong urban area of Hai Phong, Vietnam, at the addresses above.

Q: Do you offer online yoga classes for beginners?
A: Yes — live, small-batch classes with dedicated beginner guidance, joinable from anywhere in the world.

Q: Do you adapt yoga practice for individual needs?
A: Yes. Yog Jivan can adapt non-medical yoga instruction around a student's experience, mobility, comfort and practice goals. Yoga complements — it never replaces — medical care, and we do not promise specific medical outcomes.

Q: Do you offer private one-on-one yoga sessions?
A: Yes — in-studio in the Hai Duong urban area and online worldwide, personalized to each student.

Q: How much do Yog Jivan live online yoga classes cost?
A: Live online group memberships are $36 for 1 month, $99 for 3 months, $180 for 6 months and $300 for 12 months (USD). Private 1-on-1 and corporate pricing is quoted individually by enquiry.

Q: What makes Yog Jivan different from a pre-recorded yoga app?
A: Classes are live, not recorded. Group size is capped at 8 students with camera on, so a teacher sees your alignment and corrects you by name during the session.

Q: Which languages are classes taught in?
A: English, Vietnamese and Hindi, subject to teacher availability. Master Anil Choudhary personally teaches and communicates in all three.

Q: Who teaches private 1-on-1 online sessions?
A: A teacher from the Yog Jivan teaching team is matched to the student, and sessions are generally kept with that same teacher for continuity. Master Anil Choudhary is the founder and sets the teaching standard.

Q: Can I join Yog Jivan online classes from outside Vietnam?
A: Yes. Live online classes are joined from anywhere in the world; students span 20+ countries, and session times are arranged around your time zone for private sessions.

## Health note

Yog Jivan offers yoga and wellness instruction, not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Please consult your doctor before starting if you are pregnant, recovering from injury or surgery, or managing a diagnosed condition.
